attributes.context: Article 44, Management Rights, states that the Employer retains broad management rights, including the right to introduce new or improved methods, techniques, and/or equipment, unless limited by the Agreement.

extraction_text: Except as otherwise limited or restricted by a provision of this Agreement, the Employer has and shall retain the full right to manage the business and direct the work force. These management rights shall include, but not be limited to, the management of the business; to plan, control, increase, decrease, change or discontinue routes or operations in whole or in part; to introduce new or improved methods, techniques, and/or equipment;
